column1: # What the Plants Know: the plant words looked for, decided by hand.
# homograph 1: the spelling is also another word; the annotator decides each use in context.
# exact 1: matched only as written, never with an ending taken off (نیست must not become نی).
# A part of a plant counts (leaf, branch, thorn, fruit, grain, wood); a made product does not
# (wine, bread, sugar, oil, rosewater), and neither does a place (garden, meadow, rose-garden).
